Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionAn explosive mix of action and mystery, seasoned with black humor and a sinister atmosphere. Journey into Hell alongside a brave boy named Blizzy and defeat Evil itself. Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost? PUZZLES, MYSTERIES, AND ACTION Step into the twisted, magical universe of Creepy Tale—a world packed with eerie secrets, original brainteasers, and minigames that'll test your wits, agility, and stealth. To survive, you'll need to leap over deadly traps, dodge sinister foes, and crack puzzles like they're no big deal. Meet the mysterious—and downright dangerous—inhabitants of the otherworldly realm in this thrilling adventure where questing collides with action, and a gripping story ensures boredom stays far, far away. INTERACTIVE ANIMATION Creepy Tale isn't just a game; it's a haunting story for everyone. Lovingly crafted graphics summon memories of childhood tales—only darker, stranger, and far more twisted. Whether you dive deep into the narrative or just want a creepy little diversion, this game's designed to be enjoyed by the whole family. A TWISTED TALE YOU WON'T FORGET Blizzy has always craved adventure—the more dangerous, the better. Becoming a hero and saving the kingdom? That's the stuff of dreams. But a trip to Hell? Now that's a real opportunity to stretch his legs and prove his mettle. An ancient evil trying to break free? Child's play! The young and fearless Blizzy can handle anything! Your guide through Hell will be Molek, a tiny imp whose greatest joys in life are candy and children. If you're lucky enough to become one of his favorites, you'll get more than just cruel jokes—you might even get some genuinely helpful advice. After all, watching a child sow chaos is the most entertaining pastime Hell has to offer. FEATURES: - Befriend hellish denizens of the underworld—and slip away just before they decide you're dinner. - Tame enchanted butterflies to bring pictures to life. - Uncover loads of eerie nods to classic fairy tales... and much, much stranger things. - Take control of Furry: fight off a monstrous spider and escape a poisonous tower. - Shatter an ancient seal, unleash the darkness within, and try desperately to set things right. - Play with Adele—a girl with bipolar personality disorder. - Lose yourself in the handcrafted animation for dozens of bizarre characters. - And all of this is wrapped up in a haunting soundtrack and professional voice acting that'll creep under your skin. Creepy Tale is the brainchild of a small but obsessed trio, pouring every ounce of passion and dark creativity into this chilling project. Prepare yourself for a tale as unsettling as it is unforgettable. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREIn this bundleHarvest Moon: Echoes of TeradeaView gameMoonana Cow PackView add-onDescriptionPre-order now and get your hands on a yellow Moonana Cow and a retro-themed outfit! Farm, explore, and discover! Embark on an unforgettable journey through the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure! Raised in the quiet comfort of Bloomfield Village, your life is about to change forever. A mysterious mist creeps from the Forest of Echoes, wild beasts roam under the cover of night, and strange disasters threaten villages across the land. Venture across a vast, living landscape filled with hidden caves, remote islands, lively towns, and long-forgotten secrets. Between your travels, cultivate your farm, raise animals, harvest crops, and build a place to call home. Guided by the Harvest Goddess and aided by the friends you'll meet along the way, you’ll find new ways to grow, explore, and lend a hand wherever it’s needed. As friendships deepen and the seasons pass, the truth behind the mist will slowly begin to unfold. With the support of those you’ve helped — and those who stand beside you — you may discover a way to lift the veil from the Forest of Echoes and let Teradea flourish once more! • Romance & Relationships: Meet 10 unique romance candidates—5 bachelors and 5 bachelorettes. Build meaningful relationships, experience heartfelt events, and find your perfect partner to share your life with. • Animal Companion System: Befriend a variety of animal companions, each with unique abilities that help you explore. Break obstacles, reach hidden locations, and uncover secrets throughout Teradea together. • New Exploration Abilities: Jump, climb ladders, and scale vines to discover previously unreachable areas. Combine your movement skills with your animal companions to fully explore every corner of the world. • Make Everyone Happilia: Help villagers, complete requests, and contribute to Teradea's growth to earn precious Happilia. The more Happilia you gather, the more the Harvest Goddess can help restore the land. • Island Life: Discover remote islands by collecting nautical charts. Hunt for hidden treasures, uncover new locations, and befriend rare animals found nowhere else in Teradea. • Untamed Wilderness: The wilderness is home to wolves, bears, tigers, and other wildlife. Stay alert and avoid being caught, or you'll lose your collected items and wake up back at your farm.Show morePublished byNatsume Inc.Developed byNatsume Inc. / IMAGICA GEEQ Inc.Release date10/15/2026Play withXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesSingle playerOptimized for Xbox Series X|S XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
